import importlib.util
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('taskprog',p)
mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
def make(h,w,bg,pts):
    g=[[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for (r,c),v in pts.items(): g[r][c]=v
    return g
# Demo 1: validate all original marks and the two added cells.

o1=mod.transform(d1)
print('demo1 additions',[(r,c,v) for r,row in enumerate(o1) for c,v in enumerate(row) if d1[r][c]!=v])
# Demo 2 sparse marks; compare the complete expected set of non-background output coordinates.
pts2={(13,14):0,(13,17):4,(14,15):0,(14,16):4,(15,15):6,(15,16):5,(16,17):5}

print('demo2 rays', {v:[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(o2) for c,x in enumerate(row) if x==v] for v in (0,4,5)})
# Test output sparse marks / rays.
tpts={(14,11):5,(14,12):8,(15,11):9,(15,12):2,(16,10):9,(16,13):2}
